_about: Golden vectors for x_term_getline_editor (T4), driven via test-harness 'E <hex>'. Each entry: hex byte stream (printables + edit escapes + terminator 0D/1B/03) injected ahead of the editor; expect_rc = TERM_LINE_* numeric; expect_line = final buffer text. ESC=1B, CSI Left=1B5B44, BS=08 (delete-left), 0x7F=delete-right (Del key / rubout), CSI Del fwd=1B5B337E.

mid_space.desc: ab + Left + Space + Enter -> a b

mid_insert.desc: abc + Left + insert X + Enter -> abXc

delete_forward.desc: abc + Home + Right + Delete (CSI 3~) + Enter -> ac

delete_forward_7f.desc: abc + Home + Right + Del byte (0x7F) + Enter -> ac

mid_multi_space.desc: ab,c + Left + Space x3 + Enter -> ab,   c

ctrlk_kill.desc: hello + Home + Right + Ctrl-K + Enter -> h

overwrite_mid_line.desc: W12: abc + Home + Insert(toggle OVR) + XY + Enter -> XYc (replace, no grow)

overwrite_eol_extend.desc: W12: ab + Insert(OVR) + c at EOL + Enter -> abc (overwrite falls back to append)

overwrite_toggle_roundtrip.desc: W12: abcd + Home + Ins(OVR) X + Ins(INS) Y + Enter -> XYbcd (overwrite then insert)
